correctness.rationale: PASS: Direct graph is C(2n;1,n) with original cubic graph H1 rank n+1. For n=3,4 diameter2 so full simplices at scale2. At n=5 I independently constructed all 122 faces (f=(10,35,50,25,2)) from distance-two neighborhoods, replayed every one of the 48 Git-certificate elementary free-face pairs against every remaining coface, and found precisely 26 faces of the octahedral S² boundary on six vertices. Computed all 20 signed simplicial Lefschetz sums for r^a s^b; each equals 1+(-1)^(a+b), hence r,s act by −1 on integral rank-one H2. For n>=6 the proof explicitly covers every face by a cone on three adjacent rungs; intersections of distinct windows are full simplices on one or two consecutive rungs. The only exceptional n=6 projected alternating triangles cannot lift because of Möbius twist (six rim steps reverse the sheet), making the nerve lemma applicable; its nerve collapses by n free triangle/chord pairs onto C_n, naturally dihedral-equivariantly up to homotopy, yielding stable integral H1=Z with r=+1,s=−1. Every scale2 edge can be replaced across a triangle by length<=2 scale1 path, so H1 scale1→2 is surjective of rank1 for n>=6 and zero otherwise. Bounded n checks supplement, not prove, the all-n good-cover argument.
